spec.description: Schema explorer snapshot cache per API instance: hit rate, where misses are served from and what they cost, evictions, and whether SCHEMA_EXPLORER_CACHE_MEMORY_MAX_MB should be raised.

spec.expr: 100 * (sum(increase(api_schema_explorer_cache_requests_total{source=~"memory|inflight", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(increase(api_schema_explorer_cache_requests_total{source!="none", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) or vector(0), 1)

spec.description: Share of explorer requests served from memory (or by joining a load already in progress) in the selected range. Requests for versions without a schema are left out.
spec.title: Hit rate

spec.description: Explorer snapshot requests in the selected range, all sources.
spec.title: Requests

spec.description: Snapshots built from the schema (neither in memory nor in Redis) in the selected range. Each build parses and walks the full schema.
spec.title: Snapshots built

spec.description: Snapshots dropped from memory to stay within the size limit in the selected range.
spec.title: Evictions

spec.description: Share of misses (Redis loads and builds) for versions the same instance evicted within the hour before. Clearly above zero while memory is full means the cache is too small; raise SCHEMA_EXPLORER_CACHE_MEMORY_MAX_MB.
spec.title: Misses a bigger cache avoids

spec.description: Memory used by the fullest instance's cache, as a share of its limit (SCHEMA_EXPLORER_CACHE_MEMORY_MAX_MB).
spec.title: Fullest cache

spec.description: Where each explorer request got its snapshot, per chart interval. memory: cached on the instance; inflight: joined a load already in progress; redis: loaded from Redis; build: built from the schema; none: the version has no schema.
spec.title: Requests by source

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (pod) (increase(api_schema_explorer_cache_requests_total{source=~"memory|inflight", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (pod) (increase(api_schema_explorer_cache_requests_total{source!="none", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

spec.description: Share of requests served from memory or by joining an in-progress load, overall and per pod.
spec.title: Hit rate

spec.description: Time to get a snapshot that was not in memory: p50 and p95 for Redis loads (download, decompress, open) and builds (load SDL, parse, encode, store).
spec.title: Miss cost: load duration

spec.description: Event loop lag of the API pods. Building a snapshot on the main thread blocks the event loop; spikes that line up with builds point to that.
spec.title: API event loop lag

spec.description: Snapshots dropped from memory per chart interval. evict: removed to stay within the size limit; too_large: larger than the whole cache, never kept (only a higher limit helps).
spec.title: Evictions

spec.description: Misses for versions the same instance evicted within the hour before (a larger cache would have served them), against all misses.
spec.title: Misses after eviction

spec.description: How long snapshots were in memory before they were evicted. Minutes mean the cache churns; hours mean only cold versions are dropped.
spec.title: Age of evicted snapshots

spec.description: Estimated memory of the snapshots each instance keeps (buffer, decoded names, descriptions read so far), against the limit. A pod pinned at the limit with evictions and misses after eviction needs a larger cache.
spec.title: Memory used per pod

spec.description: Number of schema versions each instance keeps in memory.
spec.title: Snapshots in memory per pod

spec.description: Estimated memory of the snapshots put into the cache (p50, p95, max bucket). Divide the limit by the median to see how many typical schema versions fit.
spec.title: Snapshot size

spec.description: How many median-sized snapshots (over the selected range) fit into one instance's cache limit.
spec.title: Typical snapshots that fit

spec.description: Snapshots larger than the whole cache in the selected range. They are rebuilt or reloaded on every request; only a higher limit helps.
spec.title: Too large to cache
